name: System Control
description: Monitor and manage high-level system states and information.

actions.name: system_status
actions.description: Returns CPU usage, RAM/swap, disk usage, uptime, top 5 processes, and temperature (if available).

actions.name: hardware_info
actions.description: Returns CPU model, total RAM, disk information, GPU details, and network interfaces.

actions.name: os_info_extended
actions.description: Returns detailed distribution info, kernel version, hostname, current user, desktop environment, and timezone.

actions.name: save_snapshot_state
actions.description: Generates a comprehensive system snapshot bundle (status + hardware + OS + processes + basic network) saved to the project's work artifacts directory.
